metadata.what_this_is: The subset of forum-derived documentation gaps whose actual solution is an UNOFFICIAL community workaround, a hack/trick, an undocumented or internal API/endpoint, a CLI-only operation, code written purely to bypass a native limit, exploitation of unintended behavior, a third-party tool, or a feature request with a passed-around workaround. These are flagged separately so you can decide (a) whether each is safe to put in official docs or too unofficial / a support burden, and (b) which should instead be sent to PMs as a product gap to fix at the source. NOTE: these items are NOT removed from the first JSON file; this is an overlay/triage view.
metadata.selection: Each of the 361 gaps in the source file was classified as either an officially-supported-but-undocumented feature (left out of this file) or workaround/hacky/unofficial (included here). 174 of 361 were flagged.

field_notes.support_burden_risk: estimated risk that documenting this raises support load (fragility, version-dependence, easy to misuse)
field_notes.underlying_product_gap: the missing product capability that forces the workaround — PM-facing
field_notes.pm_action: send_to_PM = worth routing to Product to fix at the source

items.topic: Finding entity IDs for API calls (variable ID, dataset info via ryuu)
items.workaround_summary: To get a variableId for requestVariablesUpdate, users hit an undocumented functions/search query endpoint; and they must learn that ryuu.js/domo.get requests only resolve against the Domo backend when the app is hosted (they point at localhost during local dev).
items.support_burden_rationale: 222 views across 2 threads; ID discovery and local-dev resolution gotchas are recurring developer blockers.
items.underlying_product_gap: No documented, first-class way to discover a variableId; local-dev resolution behavior of domo.get/ryuu.js is opaque.
items.doc_rationale: Document how to obtain a variableId and the hosted-vs-local resolution caveat, but note the functions/search endpoint is the current (semi-internal) means rather than a stable public API.

items.topic: Selecting a subset of columns for a View / one-way SQL Editor switch
items.workaround_summary: Views only offer 'remove column' not 'keep these', so for wide datasets users select-all-and-delete then re-add the few columns wanted; and once switched to the SQL Editor you can't return to the GUI, forcing Beast Modes to be written in SQL.
items.support_burden_rationale: Tedious but low-stakes; single low-view thread.
items.underlying_product_gap: No keep-subset (whitelist) column selection in Views; GUI-to-SQL Editor switch is one-directional.
items.doc_rationale: The select-all-delete tip and the one-way SQL switch are worth documenting; the missing keep-subset UI and irreversible switch are PM-worthy gaps.

items.topic: Salesforce connector 2,000-row cap without unique ID
items.workaround_summary: The Salesforce report connector caps at 2,000 rows unless the report has a unique ID column; users work around it by adding a unique ID column to the report or rebuilding the report logic as a SOQL query.
items.support_burden_rationale: Silent 2,000-row truncation on large standard reports causes data-completeness confusion; recurring connector limit.
items.underlying_product_gap: Salesforce report connector cannot paginate beyond 2,000 rows without a unique ID column.
items.doc_rationale: Document the limit and the add-unique-ID / SOQL workarounds, and flag the native pagination limit to PM.

source_posts.title: Cannot retrieve more than 2000 rows without a unique ID in Salesforce Connector

items.topic: Dashboard navigation aids: jump-to-section buttons, child-page TOC, manage-dashboards search/sort
items.workaround_summary: No native in-dashboard navigation buttons, child-page TOC, or Manage Dashboards search/sort; users build a text card with a same-URL anchor link to jump around, or migrate to App Studio tabs.
items.support_burden_rationale: Anchor-link text-card trick is brittle but low-volume; mostly an enhancement ask.
items.underlying_product_gap: Dashboards lack jump-to-section navigation, auto child-page TOC, and search/sort in Manage Dashboards.
items.doc_rationale: The anchor-link navigation workaround can be documented with a caveat that it's not a native feature; the TOC and Manage Dashboards search/sort are feature requests for PM.

items.support_burden_rationale: Negligible engagement (2 views); narrow known issue.
items.underlying_product_gap: No reliable rendering for scheduled reports/alerts delivered to Microsoft Teams; no toggle for CSV attachment on existing schedules.

items.support_burden_rationale: 159 views/3 threads; security/rotation concerns make this a recurring enterprise ask.
items.underlying_product_gap: No broad service-principal / OAuth client-credentials auth across connectors (esp. Databricks/Azure).
items.doc_rationale: Mostly a feature request; the only documentable now is making the existing Databricks OAuth M2M connector discoverable, but the broader capability belongs with PM.

items.topic: Cloud Amplifier dataset/view metadata: run history, last-run date, row counts
items.workaround_summary: Cloud Amplifier (Snowflake) datasets/views don't surface run history, accurate last-run time, or row counts, so users misread live data as stale; no real workaround beyond reinterpreting freshness manually.
items.support_burden_rationale: 215 views; 'my data looks stale' on live datasets is a confusing, ticket-generating perception issue.
items.underlying_product_gap: Cloud Amplifier datasets/views lack run history and accurate last-run/row-count metadata.
items.doc_rationale: Document why CA datasets show no run history/last-run/row count and how to interpret freshness; route the missing-metadata capability to PM.

items.workaround_summary: Forms can't filter or sort the dataset that defines dropdown choices, show which datasets power them, or branch conditionally; users pre-build a filtered/sorted dataset to control and order the choices presented.
items.support_burden_rationale: Low volume; the pre-filtered-dataset workaround is a known pattern but niche.
items.underlying_product_gap: Forms lack choice filtering/sorting, dataset-governance visibility, and conditional branching.

items.topic: PDP Automation supporting column policies, not just row policies
items.workaround_summary: PDP automation applies row masks automatically but column masks must be applied manually per dataset; users manually configure column masking as the only path.
items.support_burden_rationale: Single low-view thread; manual column masking is tedious but understood.
items.underlying_product_gap: PDP automation does not extend to column-level policies.
items.doc_rationale: A one-line scope note (row-only automation, column masks manual) sets expectations; column-policy automation is a feature request for PM.

items.topic: Calling external APIs from Pro-Code apps blocked by CORS
items.workaround_summary: Browser fetch() from a Pro-Code app to an external API fails on CORS due to the app sandbox; the recommended pattern is to proxy the call through a Code Engine function (works in Postman/backend but not from the browser).
items.support_burden_rationale: CORS failures on external API calls are a common, confusing dev blocker; the proxy pattern isn't documented as such.
items.underlying_product_gap: Pro-Code apps cannot make direct cross-origin calls to external APIs from the browser.
items.doc_rationale: The Code Engine proxy is the sanctioned pattern and worth documenting with a caveat that direct browser calls are blocked by the sandbox/CORS.

items.topic: Setting upsert / primary key on a dataset (CLI vs pydomo/Python SDK)
items.workaround_summary: pydomo can't set upsert keys, producing duplicates; users must use the CLI define-upsert command or a schema-based (schema-upsert.json) SDK config to mark a column as an upsert key.
items.support_burden_rationale: 152 views; duplicate rows from missing upsert support is a high-impact data-integrity issue, and the fix is buried in unrelated app guides.
items.underlying_product_gap: pydomo lacks native upsert-key support; no general dataset-level reference for defining an upsert/primary key.
items.doc_rationale: Document the CLI define-upsert / schema-upsert.json approaches as the supported path, noting pydomo's lack of native support; flag the SDK gap to PM.

items.topic: Group access to dashboards intermittently failing (group vs individual share propagation)
items.workaround_summary: Group-based page access sometimes fails to propagate to all members until shared individually; the relied-on fix is to remove and re-share the dashboard with the group (a workaround for buggy propagation).
items.support_burden_rationale: Access failures are high-urgency for users even at modest volume, and the remove/re-share fix is undocumented.
items.underlying_product_gap: Group share propagation to dashboards is unreliable.

items.topic: Custom connector IDE timeout / session kick-out
items.workaround_summary: The connector IDE logs developers out mid-typing with no configurable timeout, losing context; the only mitigation is to save/commit work frequently.
items.support_burden_rationale: 121 views/1 thread; annoyance-level, no data integrity impact.
items.underlying_product_gap: Connector IDE has a short, non-configurable session timeout with no warning.
items.doc_rationale: Primarily a feature request (configurable timeout); only a thin save-often note is documentable, so route to PM.

items.topic: Deep links / shareable filtered dashboard views
items.workaround_summary: No UI to auto-generate a deep link capturing current filter state; users hand-construct pfilter URL parameters and object-ID-based page/card URLs (mycompany.domo.com/page/.../kpis/details/...) to share filtered views in-app.
items.support_burden_rationale: 232 views; manual URL construction is error-prone and pfilter deep-linking is only documented for embeds.
items.underlying_product_gap: No native way to generate a shareable deep link capturing in-app dashboard filter state.
items.doc_rationale: Document the interim pfilter/object-ID URL-construction pattern for in-app use with a caveat; auto-generation from the UI is a feature request for PM.

items.support_burden_rationale: Low engagement (11 views); cost-sensitive but narrow.
items.underlying_product_gap: No control to limit or pause per-card query consumption on the Overview page against live cloud sources.
items.doc_rationale: Document the per-card Overview query consumption behavior and that caching mitigates it; the limit/pause control is a feature request for PM.
